titles.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE individual LEGENDARY collectible military medal icon for a Japanese stealth tank game. Meaning: conquer every battlefield / clear all six normal stages, title 'Conqueror of All Battlefields'. Centered straight-on front view, square canvas, genuinely transparent background, full medal entirely visible with generous 8% transparent margins. Unified premium game-medal construction: short folded woven ribbon at top in emerald, royal blue and gold stripes; small gold suspension ring; large circular pendant with faceted octagonal GOLD and PLATINUM outer rim; rich deep emerald-blue enamel, full gold laurel wreath. Central sculpted relief: a prominent golden victory flag planted above a golden globe / compass, with SIX small clear gold stars arranged around the globe to symbolize six completed stages. Beneath the flag, restrained tiny heraldic motifs of a fortress gate, a closed document dossier and a capture-point pennant, all integrated into one clean coherent relief, no separate badges. Highest legendary tier, prestigious, polished, bold and readable at 76px, warm metallic reflections and precise engraved details, elegant royal color accents but less rainbow extravagance than a supreme mythic award. Lighting from upper left. No lettering, no numbers, no logos, no real-world flags, no external background scene, no detached sparkles or shadow outside the object. This award DOES have its short woven ribbon, like a traditional military decoration.

titles.prompt: Edit the provided supreme jeweled bomb achievement emblem. Change ONLY the CENTRAL planted demolition mine. (1) Rotate the central mine to a perfectly straight-on frontal view of its circular top face, parallel to the image plane, zero tilt, zero perspective foreshortening: the mine's perimeter and the ruby central button are true circles, radial ridges equally sized and symmetrical, no more visible bottom/side wall than the top, no downward angled cylinder. Retain the same overall disk silhouette, radial segmented panels, raised radial ribs and central red domed jewel button. (2) Replace ONLY the mine's grey iron/steel surfaces and grey radial ribs with beautifully TRANSLUCENT optical crystal / faceted clear gemstone, subtle pale aqua and opalescent rainbow dispersion, crisp refractive edges, luminous polished transparent glass, visible internal reflections and light transmission, recognizable three-dimensional radial segmented form; no dull grey opaque iron. Keep the ruby-red central button red and gemstone-like. Preserve the rich gold/platinum outer starburst, rainbow colored gemstones, gold laurel wreath, ornamental structure, symmetry, relative sizing, framing, relief illustration style, and background transparency. No hanging ribbon, fabric or suspension. Do not add text. Preserve the entire elaborate outer emblem exactly as closely as possible. True transparent background.
